body:
Extract the existing bounded queue HTTP protocol into an independently supplied fetch, base URL and timer capability. The existing view composes it without changing queue acquisition ordering, and a completed server issuance receipt still triggers a fresh authoritative queue read.

Focused queue/decoder/producer suites passed 93 tests and browser typecheck passed at 67fd0e7e52d5cc081ec545440e072f140587dd19. Direct tests cover original server-issued identity, pending/unknown and foreign receipts, cancellation, completed and nontransient holds, retry classification and the poll bound. Independent review and assembled playable-next acceptance remain pending.

## Summary by Sourcery

Extract queue acquisition into an authority-aware, independently supplied transport while preserving existing Study queue behavior.

New Features:
- Extract the bounded Study queue HTTP protocol into an independently configurable transport with injected fetch, authority, and timer capabilities.

Bug Fixes:
- Prevent stale queue operations and receipts from affecting state after a Study connection changes.
- Ensure completed queue issuance receipts trigger a fresh authoritative queue read rather than being treated as queue data.

Enhancements:
- Preserve queue acquisition ordering, cancellation behavior, retry classification, transient-hold handling, and bounded operation polling while moving the protocol out of the view.

Tests:
- Add focused transport coverage for operation identity validation, receipt handling, cancellation, retry bounds, transient and nontransient holds, and authority changes.
title: Extract bounded Study queue transport
